info.name: Flying Bird - Subscriptions + Session + Games + Builds (all cases)
info.description:
Every case of the new / changed requests: streamer subscriptions, the 30-day session games managed from the dashboard, and the optional build-integrity check.

**How to use**
1. Variables tab: set `adminPassword` (and `baseUrl` for the live server).
2. Run collection (in order). It creates its own test accounts (prefixed with a random `runId`) and deletes them at the end.
3. Requests marked **[reference]** are skipped when running; open their saved example to see the response.

Every request has a saved example with the real response.

**Game rules**
- any 401 -> login screen
- 403 BANNED -> "account banned"
- 403 GAME_DISABLED -> "this game is currently unavailable"
- 403 NO_SUBSCRIPTION / SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_STARTED / SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED -> "subscription ended, contact the admin"

item.description: Admin login + test dates. Run first.

Put the dashboard password in the `adminPassword` collection variable first.

Also prepares a unique `runId` (so the test usernames never clash) and the dates used below.

item.name: 2. Game - Login  (POST /login)
item.description:
Order of checks: gameId -> input -> too many attempts -> username/password -> banned -> **subscription** -> device lock.

The subscription is checked before the device lock, so an expired account never locks a device.

On success: `token` + `session.expiresAt` (30 days) + `subscription` (`null` = never expires). Save the token and deviceId on the device.

request.description:
First login locks the account to `deviceId`. Save `token`.

`session.expiresAt` = now + 30 days. `subscription.daysLeft` can be shown to the streamer.

exec: pm.test('session.expiresAt about 30 days from now', () => pm.expect(Math.round((new Date(j.session.expiresAt) - Date.now()) / 86400000)).to.eql(30));

item.name: 3. Game - Session check  (GET /session)  [NEW]
item.description:
Call **every time the game opens**, with the saved token. No body.

Headers:
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- `X-Device-Id: <same deviceId as login>`

A valid call pushes the session **30 days forward** (`session.expiresAt`). The token stays the same.

Game rules:
- 200 -> continue to the main menu
- any 401 -> login screen
- 403 BANNED -> "account banned"
- 403 GAME_DISABLED -> "this game is currently unavailable"
- 403 NO_SUBSCRIPTION / SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_STARTED / SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED -> "subscription ended, contact the admin"

request.description: Nothing saved yet (first launch) -> the game can skip this call and show the login screen directly.
Also returned when the account was deleted by the admin.

item.name: 6. Admin - Set / renew subscription  (POST /admin/users/:id/subscription)  [NEW]
item.description:
Body: `{ startsAt, months }` - `startsAt` ISO date, `months` 1-12.

- `startsAt` **inside the current period** (e.g. its last day) -> months are **added on top** of the remaining days, the old start date is kept.
- `startsAt` after the period ended / no period before -> a new period from `startsAt`.
- `startsAt` in the future -> `not_started` until that day.

Does **not** log the player out. Months are calendar months (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29).

item.name: 6.1 Renew from the last day -> months added on top (start kept)

request.description: This is what the dashboard does by default for a running subscription.

item.name: 7. Admin - Games  [NEW]
item.description:
Games are managed from the dashboard (stored in the database). `GAMES` in `.env` is only a seed: games listed there are added once if missing.

- `gameId` never changes (it is on every account and the game sends it). Only `name` (display) can be edited.
- **Disabled** game: login, /session and /play return `403 GAME_DISABLED` immediately for all its accounts; enabling it brings everything back.
- **Delete** works only when the game has no accounts (`409 GAME_HAS_USERS` otherwise: disable it instead).

request.description: `games: [{ gameId, name, active, users, createdAt }]`. `users` = number of accounts on that game.
`gameId`: 2-40 chars, lowercase letters, numbers, `-`. `name`: 1-60 chars. Works right away, no redeploy.

8. Admin - Build integrity  [NEW]
item.description:
Optional, off by default (`ENFORCE_BUILD_CHECK`). The game sends `X-Build-Hash` (sha1/sha256 of its own executable) on every request. The admin registers each official release's hash here.

- **Soft mode (default):** an unrecognized or missing hash is only logged on the account (`suspiciousBuild`, shown as an alert in the dashboard). Nothing is blocked — this is what 8.6-8.10 show.
- **Hard mode (`ENFORCE_BUILD_CHECK=true`):** the same mismatch gets `403 BUILD_MISMATCH` on /login, /session and /play (8.11, reference only here since it needs a different server flag).

request.description: `enforced` says whether ENFORCE_BUILD_CHECK is on for the server right now. `builds` is the official hash list for this game.

`hash`: 40 (sha1) or 64 (sha256) hex chars — the game's own executable hash, computed at launch and sent back as `X-Build-Hash`. Register it right after you make an official release, before distributing it.

response.name: 409 Conflict BUILD_EXISTS

request.description: Must be 40 or 64 hex chars (sha1/sha256). Anything else is rejected.
